attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "The change alters core shape-descriptor discovery logic (iterating over possibly-multiple features per binding strategy/service type instead of one) in DefaultShapeTableManager and ShapeAttributeBindingStrategy, which underpins shape rendering for every module/theme/tenant, and if GetFeaturesForDependency returns empty for previously-single-feature-mapped types the shape may silently fail to register."}
